about: The MCP server's contract: the one server 'quelvio', its tools with their titles, hints and inputs, and the sentences a tool returns on a failure.

prompt.description: The person's prompt, word for word.

project.description: The project, for an agent that reaches Quelvio only through MCP. An agent's default project comes from its first session, so its first memory_start must send it; later ones may leave it out for the default. With no project and no default yet, the call is refused on project.

people.description: The email addresses of everyone who can read your replies, your own account left out, the whole list each time; leave it out when the person is alone. A client sends at most 50; a longer list counts as a group with a guest and is never refused.
